record.label: Late physical-local innovation oracle and source boundary
record.summary: The independent frontier audit solved its localization objective, not a deployable estimator. On 40 native-J validation networks, exact q10:q15 physical local innovations reduce final MSE from 3.1072e-8 to 6.3151e-9; no single local defect is sufficient. The rank-0 unsnapped exact-MUB measurement has 5.2390e-7 endpoint error, 252.5 times its beta=1 allowance, so direct Kerdock measurement does not supply that oracle.
record.terminal_criterion: Solved as a source-localization and noise-envelope audit only; production must synthesize the missing state without using its oracle truth.
